fusions.name: False Trail
fusions.desc: Seizes up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, deals 8 damage to each and stuns them for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pounce From Cover
fusions.desc: A pounce that deals 26 damage, always lands as a critical hit, and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Gone to Earth
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 15%. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dusk Prowler
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage.
